outcome: Fetal middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA-PI)
cohort: The study included 32 preeclamptic pregnant women and 32 gestational-age-matched pregnant women with uncomplicated singleton pregnancies as a control group.
finding: Maternal serum SCUBE1 levels were significantly higher in preeclamptic women and significantly correlated with the maternal uterine artery pulsatility index.
